_meta.description: VANILLA Morrowind spells and magic-effect base costs parsed from the game ESMs: all 1,065 spells/powers/abilities/diseases with effects, plus the 141 magic effects with school and base cost. VANILLA BASELINE ONLY.

conventions.vanilla_baseline: Shipped-game data. The server can retune spell costs, effects, or effect base costs; captured NP differences belong in an np_override field per record (none recorded yet). NP-side casting math lives in mechanics.json (formula:spell-cast-100-cost).
conventions.types: type: spell (castable), power (once/day), ability (constant), blight/disease (afflictions). autocalc spells derive displayed cost from effects at runtime.
